If you are coming here from Tony Hawk, I wouldn't recommend. It's like Tony Hawk but without the sense of freedom. You can't ollie high like in THPS, so actually exploring around the map by skating is difficult. If it was to be a simulator it would make sense, but then you can scale massive walls and buildings like in assassin's creed. There's no balance when grinding, you just stay static. Overall I just wouldn't recommend it

The absolute bare minimum. That's what you can expect from an EA title. And that's what's on display here. A pathetically small map compared to any modern game or any previous skate title that hasn't been expanded in an entire year since release aside from temporary paywalled event areas where there's nothing to do but hit the same programmed mega-ramp line over and over again because it's devoid of any decent actual skate spots. Not to mention the fact that I couldn't even play for months after switching to linux until reskate came out because you just had to put a kernel level anti cheat in a non competitive game. Now that reskate is out I think i speak for all of us when I say I couldn't give a f@#% what ea does with the game going forward, the community has done in a few days what you've refused to do for years. Thanks for the foundation I guess.
